top_signals.title: A Fundamental Problem With the Economy
top_signals.summary: The US economy isn’t in crisis, but US consumers seem to be, despite stable growth, low unemployment, a relatively low rate of inflation and robust retail spending, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Kathryn Anne Edwards says. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Rise as Oil Slide Buoys Sentiment: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity futures rose, signaling some respite after a bruising selloff in the artificial intelligence trade, with falling oil prices helping investors to start the month on a positive note.
